h: The Journeying Ark and the Return to Primordial Rest

p: In the Baal HaTurim on this parshah it is stated
that in the pasuk "And it was, when the Ark journeyed" (Bamidbar 10:35)
as there are in the pasuk
at the end of the Torah;
and in the pasuk "And when it rested"
which is the beginning of the Torah;
as a book in its own right.
Now according to this hint it needs to be understood
corresponds to the pasuk at the end of the Torah,
and afterward the number seven words,
corresponding to the pasuk at the beginning of the Torah;
whereas in the Torah it is the reverse:
to the twelve tribes of Yah,
as we said regarding the intent of
And it is the gematria of zeh:
seven, corresponding to the seven attributes,
and five, corresponding to the five shepherds,
the three Avos and Moshe and Aharon,
and built the house of Yisrael.
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 115b):
that Knesses Yisrael is called zos,
But the essence of Knesses Yisrael
which is the attribute of Malchus,
and the two heads of Yisrael,
the tribe of Yehudah and the tribe of Yosef
and they are called also by the name of Yehudah,
And from them come the two Mashiachs:
through whom will come the victory
over the nations of the world,
and he will clarify the holiness of Yisrael,
that they are in the state of
and he will be the preparation
when HaKadosh Baruch Hu will slaughter
and there will be the completion of repose,
and "there will be no survivor of the house of Esav" (Ovadiah 1:18).
And then there will be the union,
that they will be called "My people and My nation,"
"and He did not cease cherishing them
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה סוֹף פָּרָשַׁת פְּקוּדֵי)
as Chazal said (Shemos Rabbah, end of Pekudei, 52:5).
And then they will be called
by the term zeh, a masculine term,
for Yisrael crown, as it were,
"with the crown with which His mother crowned Him
on the day of His wedding" (Shir HaShirim 3:11).
And this is hinted in the pasuk
at the completion of the Torah,
at the end of the book of the Berachah,
the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh
so that the repair would be complete,
will make a dance for the tzaddikim"
"and each one points with his finger:
Therefore it is hinted at the end of the Torah
in a pasuk of twelve words.
And the beginning of the Torah
is with the work of Creation,
הָאֱלֹהִים עָשָׂה אֶת הָאָדָם יָשָׁר (קֹהֶלֶת ז, כט)
for the sake of Yisrael, who are called "reishis";
to be the receiver of the Torah,
and to be the spirit of Mashiach.
וּמִשּׁוּם הָכִי יֵשׁ בּוֹ שֶׁבַע תֵּיבוֹת
when the Shechinah will dwell principally among the lower beings,
which is the purpose of the making of heaven and earth,
also has the Shechinah principally among the lower beings,
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah.
And that is only when there is a revelation
the union of Yud-Heh with Vav-Heh,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קט, ב)
when He is not in closeness
with His Shechinah…" and so on,
HaKadosh Baruch Hu is not one,
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן סֵפֶר וַיְהִי בִּנְסוֹעַ
Not so the book of "And it was, when the Ark journeyed,"
which corresponds to the effort in this world
to subdue the side of the north,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קנה, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 155a),
"Fortunate are those whose way is perfect,
who walk in the Torah of Hashem."
Therefore the pasuk "And it was, when the Ark journeyed"
and then they will merit the attribute of zeh,
through the holiness of the Avos
Moshe, the groomsman of the King,
and Aharon, the groomsman of the Queen.
that each one points with his finger,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרָכוֹת לד, ב)
in the manner of what Chazal said (Berachos 34b):
"In the place where baalei teshuvah stand,
this is the spirit of Mashiach
"hovers over the face of the waters,"
And then they will merit to be
forever they shall inherit the land,"
the pasuk "And when it rested he would say,"
corresponding to the seventh millennium and the World to Come,
as at the beginning of Creation,
and the Shechinah dwelt principally among the lower beings,
meaning, the attribute of Hu will be revealed
in the light that is called day
יִהְיֶה ה׳ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד (זְכַרְיָה יד, ט)
"Hashem will be One and His Name One" (Zechariah 14:9).
when we taste a semblance of the World to Come
one-sixtieth of the World to Come,
we say in the Minchah prayer,
"You are One and Your Name is One."
